caption: The drawing consists of two spoons depicted in a horizontal orientation, both drawn in grayscale on a light beige background. The top spoon is shown from a viewpoint where the handle is to the right and the bowl to the left; the handle has a detailed border pattern and an oval-shaped end, within which the letters "R E" are visible. The bottom spoon is shown below the first, also with the handle to the right and bowl to the left, and displays two inscriptions or stamps on the handle: "Runges" and "Eden". Both spoons have a traditional oval-shaped bowl, though the top spoon's handle appears thicker and more decorated. In the bottom left corner of the drawing, a smaller inset diagram shows a technical side-view of a spoon, accompanied by measurements and scale marks, all in fine lines. The overall composition is rectangular with a simple, linear border framing the drawing, and the drawing is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Spoon
